pages.title: End of Dimension Tips
pages.text: This chapter covers some tips and or tricks for rounding out this simulation.

pages.title: Unbreakable tools
pages.text: Stip mining is for inefficient cavemen. And you don't want to be inefficient do you?$(br2)Putting 5x $(item)Reinforcement modifiers$() on your tool will make it unbreakable.

pages.title: Unbreakable tools
pages.text: This can easily be achieved by leveling your tinker tool a few times, or making it with some paper parts.$(br2)Once your tool is unbreakable you can use $(l:portal_hub/2_oreexcavation)Ore Excavation$() to uncover large areas of a cave without breaking your tool.$(br2)The increased sturdiness will also make it easier to level up, so it won't take long to fit other usable modifiers, like $(item)Fortune$().

pages.title: Cobblestone Generator
pages.text: Pairing a vanilla cobblestone generator with a $(item)Mechanical Miner$() and a $(item)Mechanical Crafter$() will create a nifty little $(item)Compressed Cobblestone$() farm.

pages.title: Storing experience
pages.notes: An $(item)XP Drain$() will let you drain your experience into a fluid container when you stand on top of it. The fluid container needs to be placed under the drain.
